en-US.author: mateo-ki
en-US.description: Windows proxy subscription client with mihomo, sing-box and xray kernels and a local HTTP API.
en-US.longDescription: VCC is a Windows desktop proxy client written in C++20 with native Qt 6 Widgets rather than a webview. It collects subscription sources and nodes, measures latency with real handshakes, routes traffic through a proxy kernel according to rules, and exposes a local HTTP API. Sources support conditional HTTP requests, retries and scheduled refresh, plus Gist discovery and Telegram channel fetching. Parsed node types include `ss`, `vmess`, `vless`, `trojan`, `hysteria2`/`hy2`, `socks5` and authenticated `http(s)` share links, together with Clash and Clash Meta YAML configuration and mixed plain text. The mihomo, sing-box and xray kernels are detected locally and downloaded from GitHub releases when missing, and their child processes are placed in a Windows job object so a killed client leaves no listener behind. Traffic can be taken over through the system proxy or TUN, with five routing modes, automatic failover driven by configurable probes, per-rule hit statistics, live throughput graphs, an active connection table, kernel logs, a system tray, single-instance mutual exclusion and five themes. `--headless` runs the API without the interface.
en-US.name: VCC

zh-CN.description: Windows 桌面代理订阅客户端，内嵌 mihomo / sing-box / xray 内核，并对外提供本地 HTTP API。
zh-CN.longDescription: VCC 是 C++20 编写、使用原生 Qt 6 Widgets 界面（不是 Webview 套壳）的 Windows 桌面代理客户端，负责收集订阅与节点、真实握手测速、按规则分流跑代理，同时对外提供一个本地 HTTP API。订阅源支持 HTTP(S) 拉取与条件请求、失败重试和定时自动拉取，以及 Gist 发现与 Telegram 频道抓取；节点解析支持 `ss` `vmess` `vless` `trojan` `hysteria2`（`hy2`）`socks5` 与带鉴权的 `http(s)` 分享链接，以及 Clash / Clash Meta 的 YAML 配置和混排的裸文本。mihomo、sing-box、xray 三种内核会自动检测本地版本并在缺失时从 GitHub Release 下载（可选加速镜像），内核子进程挂进 Windows 作业对象，主程序被强杀时不会留下还在监听端口的孤儿内核。接管方式有系统代理与 TUN 两种，分流模式五种，支持故障自动切换、规则命中统计、实时上下行速率曲线、活跃连接表、内核日志、系统托盘、单实例互斥与五套主题；`--headless` 可只跑 API 不开界面。
